language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language used throughout the application.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced Motion
reducedMotion.description: Disable non-essential animations and transitions throughout the app.

compactMode.title: Compact Mode
compactMode.description: Reduce spacing in lists and tables to show more content.

autoPlayMedia.title: Auto-play Media
autoPlayMedia.description: Automatically play videos and animated GIFs as you scroll.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose which activity updates you receive.

likes.title: Notify me about likes
likes.description: Receive notifications when someone interacts with your likes.

comments.title: Notify me about comments
comments.description: Receive notifications when someone interacts with your comments.

follows.title: Notify me about follows
follows.description: Receive notifications when someone follows you.

mentions.title: Notify me about mentions
mentions.description: Receive notifications when someone mentions you.

bookmarks.title: Notify me about bookmarks
bookmarks.description: Receive notifications when someone interacts with your bookmarks.

privacy.title: Privacy Settings
privacy.description: Control who can see your content and activity.

accountVisibility.title: Account Visibility
accountVisibility.description: Manage who can interact with you.

privateAccount.title: Private Account
privateAccount.description: When your account is private, only people you approve can see your posts and followers.

activityStatus.title: Activity Status
activityStatus.description: Allow accounts you follow and anyone you message to see when you were last active.

searchVisibility.title: Search Visibility
searchVisibility.description: Allow your profile to be discovered in search results and recommendations.

security.title: Security Settings
security.description: Manage your password and security preferences.

changePassword.title: Change Password
changePassword.description: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure.
